body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Computes stress-intensity factors and predicts crack growth and remaining life. A computational fracture mechanics solver extracts J-integrals and stress-intensity factors from FE models, grows cracks with Paris-law and retardation models, and predicts remaining life. Real implementations include FRANC3D, Zencrack, Abaqus XFEM, and NASGRO. It handles mixed-mode loading, residual stress, and inspection-interval planning.

description: Computes stress-intensity factors and predicts crack growth and remaining life.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Computational Fracture Mechanics Solver, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (J-integral and interaction-integral SIF extraction). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: J-integral and interaction-integral SIF extraction and Automatic crack insertion and remeshing. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Fatigue and stress analysis program) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
